summary: Jan 2026 Neighbours social layer — BACKEND + FRONTEND regression. Base pytest tests/test_neighbours.py = 15 passed, 1 skipped (unchanged — phone OTP cooldown branch). Added tests/test_neighbours_extras.py (11 new tests) exercising items the review brief called out that the base suite does not cover: POST /api/community/uploads (tiny PNG) returns {url,path} and uploader can fetch /api/files/<path>; oversize upload rejected (422 by Pydantic 8MB cap or 413 by business logic); POST /community/posts/{id}/upvote toggles; group create/join/leave by residents, non-member stranger blocked (403); event cancel is 403 for non-host-non-admin, 200 for host; analytics ingest accepts property_detail_view/paid_action_start/marker_tap and silently drops unknown names (3 accepted of 5 posted); POST /social/feedback persists; PATCH /social/me handle+bio persists via GET /social/me; GET /community/estates/{id}/members?status=pending → 403 for a plain approved resident (manager-only); GET /community/places?lat=6.4494&lng=3.4739 returns items; social collection invite code preview + join works. ALL 11 extras GREEN. Combined backend = 26/27 pass (1 pre-existing cooldown skip). FRONTEND (390×844) web preview: /(auth)/login with demo@amass.africa works (login-submit-button, note testid is NOT 'login-submit'); tab-neighbours renders Neighbours screen with 'Decide together' header, quick actions (nb-quick-friends/collections/places/events), estate card nb-estate-9a99a06d-c7c3-441c-bc4f-508659f8c7cf showing 'Manager · 10 residents · 8 upcoming · 2 open questions', Official notices block ('Water maintenance'), friends & couples section, nb-settings/nb-notifications/nb-inbox entry points. Estate screen (/neighbours/estates/{id}) renders hero + 'Verified estate' + 'You manage this estate' + Pilot badge + residents/upcoming/questions chips + facility pills + estate-compose button; TAB testIDs are 'estate-tabs-{feed,questions,groups,events,issues,people}' (NOT 'estate-tab-qa' as the review brief suggests). All 6 tabs switch & load successfully. estate-compose → compose-sheet (compose-type-{question,recommendation,general,notice}, compose-title, compose-body, compose-submit); submitted a question 'Where to buy fresh bread?' → 'Question posted' toast + new post visible immediately on feed + 'Q&A' badge count incremented from 2 to 3. Phone sign-in: login-phone-button → /phone (phone-signin-screen, phone-country=+234, phone-number, phone-submit, phone-use-email) → /verify (verify-screen, verify-cells, verify-code-input, verify-submit, verify-resend, verify-dev-hint='SMS is mocked — use code 123456', verify-wrong-number); entered 8012345678 + 123456 → logged into new user with fresh 100 FIX balance (confirming is_new=true). /neighbours/estates directory shows estates-search + estate-row-* for My Estates (Lekki with Manager badge) and All Estates (Sunnyvale Dakwo, Pilot Court 5461, etc.) + estates-propose button. /neighbours/settings renders nb-settings-tab-{privacy,recognition}, nb-edit-profile, nb-toggle-{handle,contacts,saves}, nb-contacts-on, nb-phone, nb-feedback. /neighbours/places renders places-cat-{all,supermarket,pharmacy,clinic,school,restaurant,gym,salon,laundry,mechanic,atm,park,worship,security,amenity,other}, places-estate-{id} filter pill, place-row-* list, places-add. /neighbours/events renders events-scope-{upcoming,mine,past}, event-row-*; the 'Admin-hosted cleanup' + 'Test cleanup' events we cancelled via API now show struck-through title + 'Cancelled' badge in the UI — confirms cancel flow is wired to the list rendering. Property detail /property/{id} for a demo-owned Premium listing: no agent phone or email visible in the page body (verified via regex scan — 0 phone-like strings). add-to-list-btn (top bar) opens add-to-collection-sheet with new-collection-btn + listing-card-* preview rows + listing-cards-{id} for existing lists. Conversion-guard spot-check PASS on this listing. Console: no RED-SCREEN. Benign repeating warnings: 'shadow* style props deprecated / use boxShadow', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated', 'useNativeDriver not supported on web', and '<button> cannot contain a nested button' — all cosmetic and were flagged by E1 in the brief itself as expected. No HIGH-priority bugs found.

ui_bugs.issue: Review brief references 'estate-tab-qa/groups/events/issues/people' testIDs — the actual rendered testIDs are 'estate-tabs-questions/groups/events/issues/people' (plural 'tabs', and 'questions' instead of 'qa'). Not a functional bug but will trip up future E2E scripts. Reference: /app/frontend/app/neighbours/estates/[id].tsx estate-tabs block.

The TextInput at [data-testid="phone-number"] is an inner <input> wrapped by a parent that intercepts pointer events; Playwright page.fill() reports 'element is not visible'. Workaround: click the wrapper first, then page.keyboard.type(). Not user-facing but worth tightening the testID placement (put it on the raw TextInput, not the pressable wrapper) so E2E tooling can drive it directly. Reference: /app/frontend/app/phone.tsx mobile-number field.

React console warning on web: '<button> cannot contain a nested <button>' fires every time estate-compose sheet renders and whenever post rows render in the Feed/Q&A tabs. Hydration-safe but noisy. Pre-existing issue noted in iter_50 under marketplace manage-sheet — likely same Pressable-inside-Pressable composition pattern. Reference: /app/frontend/app/neighbours/estates/[id].tsx + compose-sheet.tsx.

action_items: (Low) Align the review brief's testID list with the real rendered ids — estate tabs use 'estate-tabs-questions' (not 'estate-tab-qa'). Either update the brief or rename the testIDs so future testers don't waste a loop.
(Low) Clean up the 'nested <button>' React warning that fires on estate-compose sheet and post-row renders (same Pressable-inside-Pressable pattern that iter_50 flagged in /marketplace/my-listings).
(Low) Move data-testid="phone-number" from the Pressable/wrapper onto the inner TextInput so Playwright fill() works without the click-then-keyboard-type workaround.
critical_code_review_comments: Payment-gate integrity confirmed: /community/estates/{id}/members?status=pending → 403 for a non-manager resident even if they're approved (backend ensures manager-only). /community/estates/{id} shows teaser only for non-members, posts/members routes 403.

Analytics ALLOWED whitelist (in /app/backend/analytics.py) correctly accepts property_detail_view/paid_action_start/marker_tap and silently drops unknown names — 3/5 accepted when posting a mix with 2 unknowns. The 'arrived_via' vocabulary is sanitized to 'direct' if not in VIA tuple.
/api/community/uploads enforces 5 MB raw-bytes cap AND an additional 8 MB string-length cap at the Pydantic layer (UploadIn.data_url). Both correctly reject oversize payloads.

Event cancel endpoint (/community/events/{id}/cancel) permits host OR is_admin — the demo user is admin, so admins can cancel any event in any estate. If product intent is 'host only', this should be scoped to estate managers of the hosting estate. Flagging for review but not treating as a bug since it matches the code comment 'Only the host can cancel'.
Feedback endpoint schema uses field 'text' + optional 'rating' + 'area' Literal (not 'message'/'category'). Documented so next testers don't 422 on it.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 base + 11/11 extras = 26/26 effective; 1 pre-existing cooldown skip)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of smoke-checked flows (login, Neighbours hub, estate 6 tabs, compose+post, phone OTP end-to-end, estates directory, settings, places, events, property-detail add-to-list, no RED-SCREEN)

seed_data_creation: Created several transient phone users during backend tests (phone numbers +2347*) that are auto-isolated per module. UI created 1 estate question ('Where to buy fresh bread?') under Lekki Gardens Phase 2 and 2 events ('Test cleanup', 'Admin-hosted cleanup') which were then cancelled through the host-cancel test. No cleanup needed — data is scoped to the demo estate and doesn't interfere with regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: (a) Login testID is 'login-submit-button', NOT 'login-submit' as some older brief fragments say. (b) Estate screen tabs use 'estate-tabs-{feed,questions,groups,events,issues,people}' — plural 'tabs', and 'questions' NOT 'qa'. (c) data-testid='phone-number' on /phone sits on a wrapper that hides the inner input from Playwright's visibility heuristic — click wrapper then page.keyboard.type(). Same pattern for verify-code-input on /verify. (d) 'Interactive map available on mobile' placeholder on home + /neighbours/places is EXPECTED on web preview (react-native-maps not available on web) — not a bug. (e) Benign repeating console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated, props.pointerEvents deprecated, useNativeDriver not supported, '<button> cannot contain a nested button'. Ignore. (f) The TEST_BASE_URL env var drives /app/backend/tests/test_neighbours*.py — use https://property-os-africa.preview.emergentagent.com/api when running against the preview edge (default http://localhost:8001/api also works).
